defects.problem: The opening accompaniment is misdescribed as alternating bass notes and offbeat chords. Its defining layer is continuous broken-chord triplet quavers, shared across the staves, beneath the tune and above the separate bass punctuation.
defects.evidence: Independently inspected printed p.3 / PDF p.2 of https://s9.imslp.org/files/imglnks/usimg/f/fe/IMSLP03060-Schumann-Op015Brt6016.pdf ; corroborating encoding https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/SchumannR/O15/SchumannOp15No01/SchumannOp15No01.ly explicitly uses triplets throughout the inner voice.
defects.fix: Describe the tune, flowing inner triplet arpeggios and separate bass layer accurately; remove the offbeat-chord assertion from the public cue and its score evidence, and replace 'same rocking left hand' in the transition with the continuing triplet motion. Retain the correct G-major/2/4 description.

defects.problem: Saying the Kinderszenen were composed by 17 February can imply the finished cycle, although the same diary records further pieces on 24 and25 February.
defects.evidence: https://www.schumann-zwickau.de/media/archiv-sonderausstellungen/2013_175_Jahre_Kinderszenen.pdf item1 records work by17 February and Träumerei on24 February, another F-major scene on25 February.
defects.fix: Say that Schumann's diary records work on the Kinderszenen by17 February, not that the complete collection was already composed. The visit on22 February and March letter may remain.
